T17 done. All checks pass.

**Overrode explicitly:** none needed a code change — `useAgentSessionStats`/`useAgentGoalLive`/`useAgentCouncilLive` (session-stats 5s, goal-live 2s, council-live 2s) already pin their own `refetchInterval`, gated only by their caller's per-pane `enabled` (checked call sites in `PaneComposer.tsx`, `Composer.tsx`, `GoalLivePanel.tsx`, `CouncilLivePanel.tsx` — none reference `isActive`), so they already survive backgrounding untouched by `instanceQueryClient`'s default. Added a module comment documenting this invariant so a future edit doesn't "simplify" it away.

**Left on default (no change, explicit reasoning):** `/agent/capabilities` (30s) — static machine-level facts, doesn't feed the chip badge. `/agent/model-config` (30s + focus) — static CLI config. Both are already explicit intervals for their own pre-existing reasons, unrelated to this task.

**Interval chosen:** none — kept every existing cadence (5s/2s/2s) as-is; none needed changing since they were never tied to the instance default in the first place.

**Header.tsx:** added `useVault()`, disabled the manual refresh button on `!isActive` alongside the existing `refreshing` check; reused the existing `:disabled` CSS, no tooltip added.

**Checks:** (1) `tsc --noEmit` clean at root and in `dashboard/`. (2) zero `isActive` matches in `agentSession.ts`/`chatSession.ts`. (3) `npm run build` exit 0. (4) scoped `git status` shows exactly `Header.tsx` + `useAgentCapabilities.ts`; the long repo-wide status is prior waves + the unrelated concurrent automations run, not mine.

**Nothing stopped on** — no changes needed outside my two files.
